stem:
Zubin designs a school badge in two stages: first he picks one of 5 colours, then one of 3 pin shapes. Every colour–shape pair is allowed.

Which plan gives the total number of badges?

options.text: Count only the 5 colours, because the pin shapes do not change the total.
The 3 pin shapes produce the 5 colours, so start from shapes and ignore colour choices.
Count only badges that use the first colour, so the total is $1\times3=3$.

teacher.key_rationale: Two-stage choices multiply: 5 colours times 3 shapes gives 15 badges. Dropping the shape stage omits a required condition. Treating shapes as producing colours reverses the relation. Counting only the first colour excludes the other stated colour choices.
